The code selects `input[type=button]` elements and an `input[type=tel]`, removes the telephone input from tab order (`tabIndex = -1`) and focuses it. Each button receives a sequential tab index and event listeners: mousedown/keyboard activation adds the CSS class `ativa`, mouseup/keyup removes it, and click appends the button’s value to the telephone input. Shift+Tab from the first button returns focus to the telephone input. The user refactored the telephone input’s keydown and keyup listeners into a `telEvents` array of `{event, action}` objects, registering them with `telEvents.forEach(({event, action}) => telInput.addEventListener(event, action))`; the keydown handler adds `ativa` for Space or Enter, and keyup removes it. The assistant's proposed full refactor selected input[type=button] elements and an input[type=tel], set the telephone input's tabIndex to -1, and focused it. Button events added or removed the CSS class ativa on mousedown, mouseup, keydown for Space or Enter, and keyup; click appended the target button's value to the telephone input. Telephone-input keydown for Space or Enter added ativa, and keyup removed it. Each button received tabIndex index + 1 and the button event listeners. On 2023-02-15, the user said they would look into finding a speech-language pathologist (SLP) in their area and were willing to complete the recommended course of speech therapy to improve their communication skills. The user asked for strategies to stay motivated during therapy.

Speech therapy duration varies with an individual's needs, goals, and the severity and complexity of the communication disorder. Some people may need a few months; others may benefit from ongoing therapy. An SLP typically assesses the person and develops goals and a treatment plan. Sessions commonly occur once or twice a week and last 30–60 minutes, though frequency and duration vary.

Speech-language pathologists can support speech clarity, receptive and expressive language, augmentative and alternative communication, cognitive-communication skills, fluency, and swallowing. Speech therapy may improve communication, confidence, and quality of life.

Suggested ways to find a speech-language pathologist include asking a healthcare professional for a referral, checking insurance directories, using the American Speech-Language-Hearing Association's Find a Pro tool, and contacting hospitals, rehabilitation centers, or schools. When choosing an SLP, consider qualifications, experience, and communication style, and consider an initial consultation.

Suggested strategies for staying motivated in speech therapy include setting realistic, measurable goals with the SLP; seeking support from family and friends; focusing on strengths and progress; practicing consistently between sessions; being patient and kind to oneself; and asking the SLP questions and seeking feedback.
